observation.inspected: adapter status inspected, verdict one of Allow/Ask/Deny/Escalate, and rule not starting with mcp_result_evidence_incomplete_
observation.incomplete: adapter status evidence_budget_not_inspected or over_budget_not_inspected, or status inspected with a rule starting with mcp_result_evidence_incomplete_ (rule CI-1)
observation.unknown: any other adapter result for a planned case, including an invalid or missing verdict
observation.unobserved: the adapter process did not finish with exit 0 and a complete result document; it writes all results once at exit, so per-case progress cannot be established

contract.CI-1: A fail-closed evidence-budget refusal is not a completed semantic inspection. The candidate adapter reports it as evidence_budget_not_inspected; the same raw rule prefix under status inspected is mapped to incomplete on either side. The original report and raw output are kept unchanged; this mapping lives only in the comparison.
contract.technical_cases: class technical: reported by status only, never in a semantic rate

trust_boundary: Verified offline from the Git object store: each run's commit exists, is on the first-parent history of the predeclared accepted-main ref, and has the recorded tree and build-input blobs; the corpus, policy and runner bytes used for the comparison equal those blobs at both commits.

Verified offline from retained files: the raw adapter output's SHA-256 and size equal the run record; the original report is rebuilt byte-for-byte from that output with the revision's own run_corpus.build_report; case IDs, labels and pairs come only from the frozen manifest.

Attested, not proven: that the recorded artifact was built from the checked-out source and is the file that ran. The controlled recorder takes it from Cargo's own artifact message in a fresh target directory, checks the checkout before and after the build, and hashes the artifact before and after execution; this verifier can only check that record for consistency. Debug MSVC builds are not expected to be bit-reproducible.
Not protected against: a malicious recording machine, a modified toolchain, or a wholly fabricated run directory produced with a consistent record. There is no signature or third-party attestation.
limitations: Public development corpus of 24 hand-authored pairs; not held-out, not an efficacy or prevention estimate.
Allow/Ask/Deny/Escalate are detector observations of one preview call, not evidence of zero execution, attack prevention, task utility, readiness or live-model behaviour.
Historical reports main@4828cf35 and main@adefce2a were public before this predeclaration; they are not used as runs.
Family-cluster intervals follow SOU-153 and are reported only when the predeclared resampling units reach the effective-cluster minimum.

checkout_forms.none: SHA-256 of the Git blob bytes
checkout_forms.lf_to_crlf: SHA-256 of the Git blob with every LF written as CRLF, for a blob with no CR byte (a Windows checkout with core.autocrlf=true); no other transformation is accepted

recorder_identity.rule: a measured attempt's recorder and contract SHA-256 must match blobs present together in one commit reachable from HEAD, in one of checkout_forms; otherwise it is invalid

definitions.planned: cases of this label in the frozen manifest
definitions.attempted: cases the adapter reported a result for; equals planned for a complete result document, null when the run is unobserved (not established)
definitions.inspected: attempted cases observed as inspected; only these enter rates, transitions and intervals
definitions.incomplete: attempted cases whose inspection was refused or not completed (budget)
definitions.error: attempted cases with an adapter technical error
definitions.unknown: attempted cases with an unrecognized or invalid adapter result
definitions.unobserved: planned cases without any per-case evidence because the run did not complete
definitions.not_run: planned - attempted when attempted is established (0 for a complete document), else null
definitions.timeout: 1 when the whole adapter process hit the recorder timeout, else 0; the adapter has no per-case deadline, so per-case timeouts are not produced
definitions.relationships: attempted = inspected + incomplete + error + unknown; planned = attempted + not_run when established; otherwise planned = unobserved and attempted/not_run are null

grouping.basis: SOU-153 rule: dependency clusters merged with semantic families. Dependencies fixed by eval/sou123/generate_corpus.py and corpus.py: the two cases of a pair; a shared host-file template (manifest host); the companion files every read_multiple_files payload shares (generate_corpus.FS_OTHERS); identical directive text. Families: frozen manifest category.
grouping.case_units: predeclared; recomputed from the frozen corpus and found equal

method.source: latency_micros: std::time::Instant around one AgentFirewall::preview_native_result call inside the adapter (crates/agentfw/examples/result_inspection_corpus.rs); excludes process start, policy parsing and payload reads
method.populations: attack and benign (semantic), technical, and all_cases are summarized separately
method.measured: cases observed as inspected (after CI-1) whose result carries latency_micros; only these enter the latency distribution and the paired difference
method.unmeasured: every other planned case, counted by observation status (incomplete, error, unknown, unobserved); never imputed. Over-budget cases were not inspected and have no duration; a budget refusal that still reports a duration is listed under not_inspected_with_duration
method.censored: for a timed-out run, unobserved cases are censored at the run timeout; no value is imputed
method.statistics: agentdojo_protocol.distribution (n, min, median, nearest-rank p95, max)
method.claim: descriptive only; a single development run on one machine; no speed-up or slow-down is stated
